title: Supervised Fine-tuning for Geometry-aware Instruction-following
abstract: arXiv:2510.26183v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We examine a contrastive input encoding scheme for supervised fine-tuning of language models (LMs) that masks the content of incorrect generations up to a classification control token. This small-scale study, using a variation of the classic word ordering diagnostic task, suggests this straightforward approach generally preserves the generation accuracy of supervised fine-tuning that uses only positive examples, while increasing the admission rate of generations in the calibrated high-probability region of a Similarity-Distance-Magnitude (SDM) estimator for binary classification of instruction-following. At the same time, we corroborate existing evidence that constructing a calibrated SDM estimator, which models the geometry of the feature-representation space, is not strictly dependent on specialized fine-tuning of the underlying LM's parameters.

translated_title: 面向几何感知指令遵循的监督微调
translated_abstract: 我们研究了一种用于语言模型（LM）监督微调的对比输入编码方案，该方案将错误生成的内容遮蔽至一个分类控制标记为止。这项小规模研究使用了经典词序诊断任务的一个变体，结果表明这种简单直接的方法通常能够保持仅使用正例进行监督微调时的生成准确率，同时提高了生成结果落入用于指令遵循二元分类的相似性-距离-幅度（Similarity-Distance-Magnitude, SDM）估计器校准高概率区域的接受率。与此同时，我们证实了已有证据：构建一个建模特征表示空间几何结构的校准SDM估计器，并不严格依赖于对底层语言模型参数的专门微调。
tldr: 本文提出一种在监督微调中遮蔽错误生成内容至分类控制标记的对比输入编码方法，在保持生成准确率的同时提高了生成结果落入几何感知的校准SDM估计器高概率区域的接受率，且无需对语言模型参数进行专门微调。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a contrastive input encoding scheme for supervised fine-tuning that masks incorrect generations up to a classification control token, preserving generation accuracy while increasing the admission rate of generations within the calibrated high-probability region of a geometry-aware SDM estimator, without requiring specialized fine-tuning of the underlying LM's parameters.
